hook.name: DegenV4FeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 fee-routing hook for Degenland's token graduation venue. Skims the entire trade fee in ETH on every swap, splitting it additively between the token creator, platform (30 bps flat), and referral (5 bps flat) using pull-based ERC-6909 accrual. Only pre-registered pools are admitted via beforeInitialize.
